narrative: From standing, at the stall. A quarto open on the board. A man's finger at the outer margin. The note there is too small to read. Close type down the page, not taken. Another hand at the corner of the leaf. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the stall, and did not bring the page away.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: His finger at the margin. His face is not in it.

entities.name: John Harrison
entities.context: His hand at the corner of the leaf. His face is not in it.

entities.name: Polimanteia
entities.context: In photo: A finger at the margin
